newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ Jan futures close weaker, below key 100.00.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ Jan futures close weaker, below key 100.00.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled weaker and under psychologically-key 100.00.

Analysts said the market is oversold at current levels. But because it is too early in the season to worry about frost damage, and with strong Florida production forecast, there is no reason for prices to climb out of their recent range.
The most-active January contract closed down 1.55 to 99.80, having ranged from 101.80 to 99.40. The back months finished 2.20 to 1.85 lower.
The Florida Citrus Processors' Association will release its weekly movement figure today.
